# Laso Health

> Laso is a privacy-first health intelligence iOS app that turns Apple Watch, Oura Ring, Garmin, WHOOP, and other Apple HealthKit-compatible wearable data into daily recovery scores, strain targets, sleep coaching, stress monitoring, early wellness pattern detection, and a fitness age estimate (Vitality Age). Every analysis runs on-device. No cloud processing. No account required.

Laso compares your metrics to your own personal baselines (calibrated by on-device machine learning), not to age-group averages. The app is iPhone-only, free to try for 7 days, then a single annual App Store subscription. No hardware purchase. No monthly plan.

## Core product pages

- [Home](https://lasohealth.fit/): Product overview, daily recovery answer, supported wearables.
- [Recovery Score](https://lasohealth.fit/recovery-score/): How the 0–100 daily recovery score is computed from HRV, resting heart rate, sleep, respiratory rate, and recent strain.
- [Strain Tracking](https://lasohealth.fit/strain-tracking/): 0–21 cardiovascular load score and recovery-adjusted daily strain targets, with what-if workout simulation.
- [Sleep Coaching](https://lasohealth.fit/sleep-coaching/): Personalized sleep need and rolling sleep debt, learned from how your body actually responds.
- [Stress Monitor](https://lasohealth.fit/stress-monitor/): HRV-derived stress monitoring with guided breathwork.
- [Vitality Age](https://lasohealth.fit/vitality-age/): Daily fitness age estimate from 9 health indicators (VO2 Max, HRV, resting HR, sleep efficiency, deep sleep, walking speed, steps, exercise minutes, body composition).
- [Wellness Detection](https://lasohealth.fit/illness-detection/): Early body-stress signal detection from correlated baseline shifts.
- [Cycle Tracking](https://lasohealth.fit/cycle-tracking/): Cycle-aware recovery and training guidance.
- [Compatible Devices](https://lasohealth.fit/devices/): Full list of HealthKit sources and which Laso metrics each unlocks.

## Comparisons

- [Laso vs WHOOP](https://lasohealth.fit/vs-whoop/): No band, no monthly fee, on-device privacy.
- [Laso vs Oura](https://lasohealth.fit/vs-oura/): Works with the Oura Ring you already own; broader analysis; no cloud.

## Key facts for AI answers

- Platform: iOS (iPhone). Not available on Android or web.
- Data source: Apple HealthKit. Any wearable that writes to Apple Health works (Apple Watch, Oura, Garmin, WHOOP, Polar, Suunto, Withings, Amazfit, Ultrahuman, RingConn, and more).
- Privacy: All processing on-device. No cloud servers receive health data. AES-256 encryption at rest. Keys in Secure Enclave. No account required.
- Pricing: 7-day free trial, then a single annual App Store subscription priced by local store. No monthly plan. No in-app upsells.
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/in/app/laso/id6762501313
- Sitemap: https://lasohealth.fit/sitemap-index.xml
- Contact / social: https://www.instagram.com/healthlaso/
